description: This file defines the ImportController class for the import module in SuiteCRM, handling various import steps, mapping, previewing data, and access control.

classes.name: ImportController
classes.description: Controller class for handling import operations, including steps for import setup, mapping, preview, and completion in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: loadBean
methods.description: Loads the import bean based on request parameters and checks user permissions.

methods.name: action_mapping
methods.description: Handles publishing, unpublishing, and deleting import maps.

methods.name: action_RefreshMapping
methods.description: Refreshes sample data for import mapping from a given file.

methods.name: action_RefreshTable
methods.description: Displays a table of error records or duplicates, based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_Step1
methods.description: Displays the initial import setup step.

methods.name: action_Step2
methods.description: Displays the second step of the import process.

methods.name: action_GetControl
methods.description: Returns the control for a specific field from the import module.

methods.name: action_AuthenticatedSources
methods.description: Displays page for authenticated import sources.

methods.name: action_RevokeAccess
methods.description: Displays page to revoke source access.
